title: E-FND-0130: the breather ladder survives the adopted rule: two of the four at-rest species are exact ladder states...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0130 in the foundations arena: the breather ladder survives the adopted rule: two of the four at-rest species are exact ladder states, their temporal spectra carrying power at precisely the harmonic ladder of one half lattice energy unit with machine-zero power off the ladder and the same weights the static-weave breather showed, while the other two rest species are broadband non-oscillator states, the sharp two-class split measured under one instrument with the broadband pair as the control.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
